title: Supported quasi-coherent derived category is generated by a perfect object
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let V be a quasi-compact open subscheme of Y, and put T=Y\setminus V. There is a perfect complex E [def-pc-perfect-complex] on Y whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T such that every object Q of D_QCoh(Y) [def-pc-derived-category] whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T is the derived colimit of a sequence 0=Q_0\to Q_1\to Q_2\to\cdots in D_QCoh(Y) in which each cone of Q_n\to Q_{n+1} is a direct sum of shifts of E.

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.15.4 and Derived Categories, Lemma 13.37.3

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-supported-perfect-generator] to the closed complement $T=Y\setminus V$. Openness of $V$ proves closedness of $T$, and the given compactness of $V$ proves compactness of $T^c=V$. Obtain the triangulated-closure proof, a perfect supported $E$, and the shifted-Hom detection equivalence.

source.place: Section Tag 0E4G, lemma-when-sheafy, proof of (3); derived.tex, lemma-write-as-colimit (Tag 09SN)

proof.text: By [lem-pc-perfect-object-compact], this given perfect $E$ is compact in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ with its canonical coproduct structure.

source.place: Section Tag 0E4G, lemma-when-sheafy, proof of (3); derived.tex, lemma-write-as-colimit (Tag 09SN)

proof.text: For each supported $Q$, apply [lem-sc-supported-derived-generated-perfect-core] to the triangulated-closure proof, the compactness proof, the support of $E$, the detection equivalence, and the support of $Q$. The elementary equivalence $y\notin (Y\setminus V)\leftrightarrow y\in V$ matches the support conventions. This gives precisely the required transition and telescope triangles.
